english.title: Persistently beg in a public place (second or subsequent offence) - Vagrancy Act 1824
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) placed yourself in a public place, street, highway, court or passage, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), to beg or gather alms having previously been convicted of such an offence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3 of the Vagrancy Act 1824 and section 70 of the Criminal Justice Act 1982.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
placed yourself in a public place/street/highway/court/passage
to beg/gather alms
having previously been convicted of such an offence

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence should not be used after 28th June 2026 due to repeal by the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022.
(ii) Made a recordable offence as from 1/12/03 by the National Police Records (Recordable Offences)(Amendment) Regulations 2003.
